forcedChoices.choice: Adjectives agree in the feminine with «la Tercera Fuente y Centro» (conocida, infinita, representada), while the pronoun stays «él» as in the English «he».
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish grammar makes the adjective agree with «Fuente»; the English pronoun is personal and masculine.

forcedChoices.choice: «ellas los conocen» refers to the personalities.
forcedChoices.reason: The English «they» can refer to «his influence and personalities»; only personalities can know, and Spanish forces a gender.

forcedChoices.choice: «el estrecho asociado» (masculine) for the Creative Spirit.
forcedChoices.reason: Agrees with «Espíritu Creativo»; this paper gives no pronoun for the Creative Spirit.
The glossary fixes «adoración» for «worship», so «adoration» needs another word.

forcedChoices.choice: «que funcionaba» can refer to the act or to the Infinite Spirit.
forcedChoices.reason: Keeps the English ambiguity of «functioning»; both nouns are masculine.
Spanish writes names of inhabitants in lowercase.
The English states a possibility with 'may possibly'; the adverb carries it, so the verb stays plain.
